record.title: Boston Globe City Desk Copy — Held from Print (1918)
record.summary: An original in-world newspaper prop written for this Apache-2.0 starter; it is not source-verbatim Chaosium text.
record.authored_text:
BOSTON GLOBE — CITY DESK COPY — HELD FROM PRINT

HOUSE ON SHEAFE STREET LEAVES A RECORD OF MISFORTUNE

A dwelling known in the neighborhood as the Crowe House has acquired a history that no agent's fresh paint can conceal. Successive tenants have departed after accidents, lingering illness, and self-inflicted death. No single public record explains the pattern, but the addresses and dates repeat with uncomfortable regularity.

The Ma family took the house early in 1918 and abandoned it within weeks, leaving no orderly notice. Neighbors disagree about what drove them out. Relatives will say only that members of the family are now receiving care in Roxbury.

The Globe has not established a criminal cause and will not print rumor as fact. The city desk is holding this feature until the property records, hospital accounts, and surviving tenants can be examined together.
record.when_to_deliver: The investigators obtain the held 1918 Globe feature or an authorized copy while researching the Crowe House or the Costas.

root.title: Mystery House
root.opening_scene: Will Howard Crane hire these people, and which Boston lead do they take first?
root.one_liner: Boston, 1920: landlord Howard Crane hires investigators for a house that will not stay rented. Official rule-gym: every lead site is stocked with CoC7 settle hooks.
root.win_condition: End the Crowe House haunting by destroying Calvin Crowe's body in the basement (best: his own ritual knife, then fire), or leave Boston. Endings: gym-ending-ash / gym-ending-fled.
root.summary: 1920sBoston，房东Howard Crane请人去查一栋租不出去的老宅。官用测试模组：每个调查点都埋了规则图谱细钩，剧情只负责把人送到出事的地方。
root.player_safe_summary: Autumn 1920, Boston. Landlord Howard Crane has a house nobody will re-let. The last tenants, the Costas, left for an asylum. Neighbors call it Crowe House. Crane pays by the day; keys and the address are available at once. He is also an unsubtle magician and will teach. A chase drill sits behind his office. The city leads — clipping morgue, library, records, police, alley gossip, former tenants, chapel ruins — are where injury, SAN, fights, a boarding-house rest, a clinic, and a ward can happen.
root.keeper_secret_summary: Calvin Crowe's corpse is sealed behind a basement partition; his will still drives the body. Mystery House is the in-house rule-gym, not a Chaosium reprint. Crane teaches Flesh Ward / Dominate / Shriveling. Hooks: clipping stack / blotter nail / parlor deadfall = injury; library plate / Dooley's story / Maria's stare / chapel familiar = SAN; Mrs. Hale = safe rest; clinic = first aid/medicine; ward = treatment; chapel familiar = combat+chase; Hatch opposed check; combined library search; jammed door = luck/push; killing the familiar = SAN gain.
root.author: Original classic scenario structure: Sandy Petersen / Chaosium. Narrative pack adaptation: chatrpgv4 contributors (original derivative prose; does not reproduce Chaosium Product Identity text).
root.attribution: Scenario structure inspired by the classic Call of Cthulhu introductory investigation 'Mystery House'. Scene names, NPC dialogue, and narrative prose in this pack are an original derivative work by the chatrpgv4 contributors. Numeric creature data for Calvin Crowe is referenced from rules-json/monsters.json.

root.open_content_note: Narrative scenes, clue wording, and NPC agendas here are original derivative work. Mechanical hooks (Flesh Ward, floating knife, own-dagger exception) align with rulesets/coc7/rules-json/the-haunting.json.

record.title: End the Ke Threat
record.player_safe_summary: Identify and end the malicious presence in the house—whether with its own ritual dagger, a cleansing rite, or another effective means—and bring the place lasting peace.
record.brief: Keeper-only: The scenario's mainline goal, arising once the haunting is confirmed rather than from any NPC's mouth. Ke animates his own corpse from the sealed basement; his own ritual dagger bypasses Flesh Ward and reduces him to ash (Vittorio's bible line hints at it). Ends only by KP semantic closure: dagger-to-ash, an equivalent sanctioned destruction, or banishment the KP accepts as final. Purely narrative completion — no machine condition can witness a destruction.

completion.narrative: Ke is destroyed or permanently ended by his own dagger or an equivalent KP-sanctioned means (reduced to ash, laid to rest, or banished beyond return); the house's threat is over.

failure.narrative: The investigators are wiped out, permanently retreat, or walk away with the haunting unresolved and Ke still feeding on the house's residents.

record.title: The Crowe House Commission
record.player_safe_summary: Crane offers a daily fee for investigating the tenants' disappearance and the strange disturbances in the house, then asks for a written report.
record.brief: Keeper-only: Crane pays $20/day plus keys and address, and wants a report that lets him rent or sell the inherited house. He knows only rumor and the Ma tragedy — nothing of Ke's undead nature — and will not believe Mythos explanations without hard proof. He pressures the investigators if research exceeds a day. The report's content is the KP's call: a whitewash he can accept, or hard proof that forces him to face the truth. Finding Ke's remains in the basement is the decisive evidence any credible report needs.

completion.narrative: The investigators deliver a report Crane accepts (a clean bill for the house, or hard proof he cannot dodge); the KP semantically confirms the commission is discharged.

failure.narrative: Crane withdraws the commission or hires someone cheaper, or the investigation is abandoned with nothing to show for it.

record.player_safe_summary: Visit the ruined chapel and recover records left by the Chapel of Contemplation; they are said to contain writings connected to Ke.
record.brief: Keeper-only: An optional research side path. The Chapel of Contemplation was broken up by a police raid and burned in 1912; its ruins still hold Father Thomas's journal-style records showing Ke's body was buried in the house basement per his will. Dooley or the court file can point investigators at the ruins. The journal materially shortcuts the basement search, so it recycles into the mainline even though the visit itself is optional.

pressure_moves: Fresh white three-Y eye symbols make nearby foreheads prickle until investigators step away
Weak floorboards call for Luck, then Jump on failure; a ten-foot fall deals 1D6 damage
The base floor hazard resolves Luck, then Jump on failure, then a ten-foot fall; do not offer a pushed Jump until its typed possession consequence is available

affordances.cue: Examine the freshly painted white triple-Y and central staring eye on the surviving wall, noting the prickling pain in your forehead as you approach.
After the weak floor collapses—or once you find a safe way down—enter the sealed ten-foot-deep cellar and examine the two skeletons in silk robes.
Search the rotting cabinet and inspect beneath it; without an explicit look under the cabinet, Spot Hidden is required, and a thorough search may be pushed.
Spend at least three hours studying or attempting to translate the damaged Latin manuscript found earlier; a check is required when Latin is below 50.
The familiar drops. Sanity then combat (aim/reload/maneuver/flee all legal). It can be chased into the gym alley.
更衣室门卡住。先普通 STR/Locksmith；失败可运气消耗或孤注一掷。
打退或杀死教堂眷族后，结算 SAN 回复（gain-current-san）。
